ai.summary: The page https://earthjustice.org/ loaded in the headless browser with HTTP 200 and no load errors. No FundraiseUp installation code was found in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request or runtime global was recorded. The verdict is not installed. Google Tag Manager container GTM-MXDNZTW was found. No GA4 measurement ID was seen loading or sending hits, which may be because it loads only after consent. Civic Cookie Control was found as the consent tool. No other donation tool was found. The donate page at act.earthjustice.org returned HTTP 403 to a plain HTTP client without JavaScript, so it could not be read. The browser did not click any buttons, so checkout and donate button behavior was not tested. No checkout form links were recorded.

customer_email.subject: Next steps to finish your donation platform setup
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us to launch online donations on your website. We ran a check on https://earthjustice.org/ and found that the donation platform code is not yet on the page.

To finish setup, please add the FundraiseUp installation code to the pages where you want donation forms to appear. Once it is added, please let us know so we can run the check again.

We also could not read your donate page at act.earthjustice.org from an automated check. It returned an access block. Please let us know if this page is meant to be public, and if any access rules apply to it.

Please also confirm whether your Google Analytics 4 property is set up and whether it loads only after visitors accept cookies.

Thank you. Please reply with any questions.

Best regards,
Onboarding Team
